# Atmospherics Systems Atmospherics has many devices for moving, controlling, and otherwise manipulating gases. These devices often work together to maintain a safe atmosphere for the crew or accomplish a shared task.
This section describes the different systems available to Atmospherics, how they connect, and how best to use them.
